cold_start_rationale: 两族里两族在冷启动（factor 8/24、information 16/24、peer 缺 dates），「任意两族」实际退化成「必须追涨」。冷启动期内：单族 + 价格确认 + 非杠杆 ⇒ 半个试探仓（1.25%）。计数器填满后此例外自动失效。2026-09-05 kcn 定。
short_history_max_age_days_rationale: 45 日历天 ≈ 30 交易日,含节假日余量(#608)
discipline: Factor and peer residual share one price-relative family. An add also requires point-in-time information surprise or own-history attention acceleration, then a future-session price confirmation. Exploration is one tranche per ticker and policy version, never a validated claim, and daily-reset leveraged products require validated evidence. Tranches are sized as a share of the market book with a per-tranche loss cap at the invalidation (sizing).

sizing.rationale: Candidate for kcn approval. Initial +18.43% book/-6.22% drawdown was a linear fixed-unit scale, not an execution replay. Actual lot, concentration, bridge, thesis and information gate replay is required before merge.
